- Shape: winds and power are generally elevated overnight with the highest single hour around 02:00 on 2026-02-27, and the lowest around 11:00 on 2026-02-27. Mean capacity factor ~0.645 implies sustained above‑average output overnight into early morning.
- Ramps / staffing: no large ramp events flagged by the model run, but the input updates showed some material revisions (max change up to 0.2241 fraction of rated) versus yesterday — be ready for up to ~0.22 p.u. adjustments in the day‑ahead when NWP updates arrive. No sub‑hourly verified bias correction available, so short-notice adjustments are possible.

Hold conservative upward and downward reserve, sized to cover the ensemble spread and the observed max update (prepare for ~0.2–0.25 p.u. contingency on day‑ahead adjustments).

Notes
- Forecast published with no bias correction (no verified history). I will re-run if new NWP arrives or if verification becomes available.
